build_MAEViT2_model: build a MAEViT2 masked autoencoder vision transformer model with configurable mask ratio and architecture
run_random_masking: run random masking on token sequences to keep a subset and generate binary masks
forward_MAEViT2: run the MAEViT2 forward pass with optional masking through convnext backbone and transformer layers
patchify_images: split a batch of images into non-overlapping patches for masked autoencoder pretraining
unpatchify_tokens: reconstruct images from patch tokens by combining non-overlapping patches back into image shape
